name: @xpx/extension
description: Extensión de navegador. Un fuente, cinco artefactos.

scripts.build: pnpm build:chrome && pnpm build:firefox && pnpm build:edge && pnpm build:opera && pnpm build:safari
scripts.build:chrome: pnpm assets && wxt build -b chrome && node scripts/publish-artifact.mjs chrome
scripts.build:edge: pnpm assets && wxt build -b edge && node scripts/publish-artifact.mjs edge
scripts.build:firefox: pnpm assets && wxt build -b firefox && node scripts/publish-artifact.mjs firefox
scripts.build:opera: pnpm assets && wxt build -b opera && node scripts/publish-artifact.mjs opera
scripts.build:safari: pnpm assets && wxt build -b safari && node scripts/publish-artifact.mjs safari
